entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Hey.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Actually, never mind. You must be tired.
I'm not tired at all.
Just say it.
What's up?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Honestly... you're amazing. There's[n]definitely something special about you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You dodge everything the enemies throw[n]at you like it's your destiny.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: At first I just thought you were going[n]to be a useful tool for me... but now[n]this is where I belong.
Are you sad about that?
That's good.
Stay here forever.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, maybe in regard to this attic place.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But... this is where I want to be.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Yeah. You're right.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Aren't you only going to be here for[n]a year?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Still... it makes me happy to hear that.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...It's not like me to say all that[n]embarrassing stuff.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But still... I think it's fine. For tonight,[n]at least.
I can sense Morgana's strong trust[n]in me...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A new power burns within me!
Morgana's Persona [clr 1]Zorro[clr 27] has[n]transformed into [clr 2]Mercurius[clr 27]!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...We should rest in preparation for[n]tomorrow.
My eyelids are starting to get heavy...
I can't keep them open any longer...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...He's repelled such an ordeal, and this[n]guy's still not being rewarded for it?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If gods really do exist...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: They're being too hard on him...
